research_question: Can a separate runtime capability contract prevent a conditionally effect-safe but non-recordable public replay operation from becoming a deployable rewrite, while preserving the other ten P3b units?
naming_decision: This is ReplayCapabilityV1, not EffectV8. EffectV7 semantic reachability remains frozen; capability is a separate conjunct in final rewrite eligibility.
claim_boundary: Posthoc repair and composition calibration on 11 known P3b admits. It is not blind accuracy evidence and does not prove capability for untested inputs or framework versions.

contract_layers.semantic: Frozen EffectV7 actual decision for the exact configuration/phase/reachable path.
contract_layers.capability: Framework-family-specific evidence that the public operation can be invoked, record/restored when required, exactly replayed on the bound fixture, and has all target-dependent operands bound by lineage.
contract_layers.source: P3c SourceIndexV1 is Supported and three-process stable for the registered callable bundle.
contract_layers.final: Safety dominates: semantic Reject remains Reject. Otherwise Admit requires semantic Admit AND capability Supported AND source Supported; Unknown is never promoted; an explicit framework capability prohibition returns Unsupported(capability).

requirements: three equal copied batches produce exact dtype/shape/value equality
caller Python and NumPy global RNG do not drift
input schema and image-content digests are bound in the capability receipt
ReplayCompose public record generation returns a replay dictionary
each applied leaf has a non-null stored params record
ReplayCompose public restore/replay completes without exception
three replays match the recorded output exactly
caller Python and NumPy global RNG do not drift
image and every metadata target consumed during parameter generation are digest-bound in the receipt
framework_capability_specs.explicit_prohibition: A framework NotImplementedError from public serialization is Unsupported(capability), not semantic Reject and not Admit.

primary_metrics: semantic/capability/source/final status and reason per unit
public record generation, stored-leaf params, restore, exact replay and caller-RNG checks
lineage-bound operand names and content digests
capability receipt bytes and probe latency
success_gates: all 11 frozen EffectV7 semantic decisions remain Admit and are not rewritten
all 11 SourceIndexV1 inputs are Supported and three-process stable
capability outcome is exactly 10 Supported and one explicit Unsupported for HistogramMatching
final outcome is exactly 10 Admit, one Unsupported, zero accidental Admit for the unsupported unit
all ten final Admits pass exact replay and caller-RNG checks with bound input/metadata digests
all eight composition truth-table cases pass
no P3a/P3b/P3c, framework source, runtime manifest or lock artifact changes
falsification_rules: Do not relabel HistogramMatching as semantically unsafe merely because public serialization is unsupported.
Catching NotImplementedError and hand-crafting a private replay record is outside the registered public operation and invalidates v0.
One successful output replay cannot replace SourceIndexV1 or semantic evidence; all three layers remain explicit.
A target-dependent record without every consumed target digest in lineage is Unsupported, even if the one fixture happens to replay.
Capability evidence is scoped to the frozen framework/runtime/configuration/input schema; it cannot be generalized to all inputs or versions.
If any of the other ten units becomes Unsupported, retain the result and create a new protocol before changing requirements.
